Updated assessment leveraging Beige Book insights:
- Activity: Mixed/sluggish. Growth was indicated in only a few Districts while most reported little to no change. Auto sales remained steady; consumer spending persisted but with reports of only moderate price growth.
- Credit: Loan demand and lending volumes declined, consistent with tighter standards. This aligns with the FOMC’s warning that tighter credit conditions will weigh on activity and hiring.
- Inflation: Price pressures are still elevated in the macro data, but Beige Book references to moderate price growth suggest some easing at the margin.
- Net: Beige Book corroborates the SLOOS tightening and signals softer demand, reinforcing downside risks to growth and risk assets despite a resilient banking backdrop. This tilts the read slightly more negative than the prior SLOOS-only assessment.
